name: Ontic Finserve Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Ontic Finserve Ltd provides investment and finance-related services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
OFL (formerly Maral Finance Limited) operates in investment and finance-related services. It plans to expand into both fund-based and non-fund-based activities, including securities trading, leasing, hire-purchase, financing, bill discounting, investments in primary and secondary markets, corporate advisory, loan syndication, and sub-broking services.
